LESSON 25 / 37 • ADDITIONAL CONCEPT
Shorthand vs longhand properties

Shorthands set multiple related properties at once; omitted components may reset to initial
values.
margin: 10px 20px කියන්Jන් උඩ සහ යට 10px, වම සහ දෙකුණ 20px. Values හතරකේ දුන්Jනාතේ
top right bottom left පිළිJවළට ගන්නවා. Shorthand එකකේ පෙසුව ලිව්Jවාතේ කලින් longhand values
Give a card different horizontal and vertical spacing.

Read the diagram: 1. Start at top. 2. Move clockwise: right, bottom, left. 3. For two values, vertical
then horizontal.
Box එක වJටේ top, right, bottom, left පිළිJවළට padding අගයන් කියවන්න.

Expected result: Margin top/bottom 10px, left/right 20px; padding top 4, right 8, bottom 12, left
16.
Interview question: What does padding: 4px 8px 12px 16px mean?
Answer: Top 4, right 8, bottom 12, left 16 pixels.
Practice: Rewrite the padding as four longhand properties.
